messages:
Daniel Kim: Hi team — I accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows 07:00 (my local UTC+8) and the Zoom link is missing from the event. Is there a separate APAC session? Who do I ping for the recording if I miss it? :wave:
Ava (Onboarding Bot): Thanks for joining, Daniel! Recording will be uploaded to Confluence (/onboarding/recordings) after the session. If you see duplicate/incorrect invites you probably got the AMER slot. Organizer: Priya Rao.
Priya Rao: Hi @Daniel — we run two live orientation slots to cover AMER and APAC/EU. Looks like you were invited to the AMER recurrence by mistake. The APAC session is on the calendar as "Orientation (APAC/EU) — Weekly" at 09:30 SGT. If you don't have that event, add this Zoom link directly: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Priya Rao: Passcode: r3dw00d (case sensitive). We'll also post the session slides and a recording afterward. Sessions run about 90 minutes.
Daniel Kim: Ah okay, that explains it. Thanks! If I miss it do you know where the recording will be stored?
Priya Rao: Recording + transcript + captions will be posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings within ~24 hours. For immediate access after the call DM me and I'll surface it.
Jamal Singh: If somebody needs live captions/ASR or other accommodations who should they contact ahead of time?
Priya Rao: Email people-ops@redwood.com or DM @people-ops on Slack. We can enable live captions in Zoom if requested at least 48 hours ahead. Also tell me here and I'll update the session metadata.
Lena Park: Quick question — is the APAC session repeated weekly for multiple weeks or just a one-off that repeats to cover different cohorts?
Priya Rao: We run the APAC live slot for the first 3 Wednesdays of the month this quarter (recurrence: 3 occurrences). If you need a calendar ICS URL: open the event -> More actions -> Export -> Copy ICS URL. Or in Google Calendar: + Add by URL -> paste ICS.
Daniel Kim: Outlook is showing the invite in UTC rather than my local time — any tips?
Priya Rao: Outlook sometimes displays DTSTART in Z (UTC) which can confuse the client. Workarounds: 1) Import the ICS into Outlook instead of subscribing; 2) Ensure your Outlook timezone setting is correct (File -> Options -> Calendar -> Time zones); or 3) accept the event and it should convert. If that's still wrong DM me and I'll send a corrected ICS.
Priya Rao: If anyone is still missing the APAC event, try searching your calendar for "Orientation (APAC/EU)" or follow the Zoom link above.
Ava (Onboarding Bot): Organizer updated event metadata: region=APAC. All attendees were re-notified. :white_check_mark:
Daniel Kim: Exported the ICS and imported it into Google Calendar — looks correct now, thanks! :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: Welcome aboard @Daniel — ping me if you have any account access troubles before orientation. We'll post the slides and recording after the call.
